_comment: Who sounds like whom, for tools/narrate.mjs. A speaker with no elevenlabs id is read by the browser's own voice (Moira, en-IE, on Apple devices) until one is cast.
_notes: The NARRATOR is the heart of it: the show's is a warm, slow, gently amused Irish man who finds everything a puffin does quietly wonderful — never a children's-TV sing-song. Oona is a bright, kind, curious little Irish girl. Baba is tiny and eager and says very little. Mama is soft; Papa is jolly and a bit proud of his flapping. May is bouncy; Mossy is quick and squeaky and delighted. Cast from the shared library with --find (accent irish), audition with --audition, and put the ids here.
_cast: Chosen 2026-09-29 from the ElevenLabs library, all Irish voices, auditioned by ear: Kevin narrates (deep, warm, soft; the user found Thomas too high). There are no Irish children's voices, so Oona, Baba and Mossy are grown voices directed small.
